contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONSTANTIVS PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP [REPARATIO]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, possibly Heraclea mint. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. A in left field. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTANTIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. A in left field. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP [REPARATIO]. In exergue: [-?] HRA. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 23.6mm, Weight: 4.49gms, die axis: 6
